slug: 西幻从骑士六艺肝出无限神职
lines: 麦收之月，丹伦王国。
黑石城堡。
萧瑟的秋风自马厩中穿过，搅动着粪臭和泥腥。
“真搞不懂，我堂堂伯爵之子，竟然让我来喂马。”
“是啊亚瑟，竟然让我们干这些下人的活计，我们父亲把我们送过来是当骑士侍童的，可不是来当马奴的。”
“也就是乡下小领主的儿子，才适合做这些。走吧亚瑟，听说拉福林骑士的女儿正在筹备舞会。”
三个衣着整洁的骑士侍童坐在草垛上，他们晃荡着双腿，把玩手里的草耙，满脸愤愤不平。
“拉福林的女儿。”当听到这几个字，三人中为首的亚瑟像是打定了主意。
听说那可是整个黑石城最美丽的姑娘，对于正处于青春期的贵族少年们来说，美女可是他们生活中的头等大事。
亚瑟带头把工具一扔，三人便朝宴厅方向跑去。
马厩中，只剩下六匹高壮的骏马和一个略显瘦削的少年。
李奥不理会离去的三人，继续给面前的高大白马整理毛发。
反正他们留在这里也只会叽叽喳喳。
“噗噗~”白马舒服的打了个响鼻，望着身旁不离不弃的清秀少年，眼神透着一丝安慰。
“好了，伙计。我不在意他们说什么。”李奥踮起脚，抚了抚白马的脖子，他便是其他人口中那个乡下小领主的儿子。
是的，李奥能听懂马叫声中的含义。
他看了眼脑海中的面板。
【李奥
职业：马夫（白）
特性：马语者（白）（沟通马匹）
技能：御马（白）二级96100（精神+0.2，初步掌握照顾马匹的方法）】
没错，李奥不是这方世界的土著，而这个面板则是在一年前跟着他一起穿越而来。
前世，他是一家世界五百强企业麾下的一名赏金送餐骑士。
但一次交通事故却把他送到了这方拥有真正骑士的异界。
不过，相比前世小说里那些穿越成渔民、乞丐，食不果腹的倒霉蛋。
李奥的穿越算的上是天胡开局，这身体的原身是一个小领主的独子。
领地虽然不大，但从小衣食无忧。
领主父亲还在一月前将他送到伟大的灰狮骑士拉福林的门下，成为了一名骑士侍童。
如果一切顺利，李奥将在两年后年满十六周岁。
到时候便有机会受封骑士侍从，踏上真正的伟大骑士之路。
不过在那之前，半个多月的喂马生活便给这四个侍童来了个下马威。
这本应是马夫的工作，娇生惯养的贵族子弟哪里能忍受马厩的肮脏和恶臭。
唯独李奥却始终勤勤恳恳。
因为面板的关系，他每日的付出都有看得见的回报。
无论是喂马、梳理马毛、清理马厩都能获得相应的经验，这半个多月他倒是乐在其中。
当他的御马技能在七天前升到二级后，他增加了0.1的精神属性，照顾起马来也越发得心应手。
“父亲说过，马是坐骑，也是战友。一名合格的骑士必须学会照顾好自己的战马。”李奥将马粪清理干净，然后开始准备今天的饲料。
清理马槽、切割草料、混合、搅拌，每一个环节，李奥都做的一丝不苟。
对于他来说，半个月的相处，这六匹马和他已经产生了感情。
相比于同届的另外三个贵族子弟。
单纯的马儿相处起来更加自在。
李奥咬牙搬起木盆，一鼓作气将调配好的草料倒进马槽。
然后他便感觉到两个硕大的马头从腋下钻出，亲热的蹭着自己。
content_en:
The Wheat Harvest Moon, Kingdom of Danlon.
Blackstone Castle.
The bleak autumn wind passed through the stables, stirring up the smell of manure and mud.
"I really don't understand. The son of my noble earl asked me to feed the horses."
"Yes, Arthur, he actually asked us to do these servants' jobs. Our father sent us here to be knight's servants, not to be horse slaves."
"Only the sons of small lords in the countryside are suitable for this. Come on Arthur, I heard that the daughter of Knight Laughlin is preparing for a ball."
Three neatly dressed knight-boys sat on the haystack. They swayed their legs and played with the rakes in their hands, with angry expressions on their faces.
"Laughlin's daughter." When he heard these words, Arthur, the leader of the three, seemed to have made up his mind.
I heard that she was the most beautiful girl in the entire Black Rock City. For the aristocratic boys who were in adolescence, beauty was the top priority in their lives.
Arthur took the lead and threw away the tools, and the three of them ran towards the banquet hall.
There were only six tall horses and a slightly skinny young man left in the stable.
Leo ignored the three people leaving and continued to groom the tall white horse in front of him.
They would just chirp if they stayed here anyway.
"Puff~" Baima snorted comfortably, looking at the handsome young man beside him who never left him, with a hint of comfort in his eyes.
"Okay, man. I don't care what they say." Leo stood up on tiptoes and stroked the white horse's neck. He was the son of the little country lord in other people's mouths.
Yes, Leo could understand the meaning of the horse's cry.
He glanced at the panel in his mind.
【Leo
Strength: 0.8 Agility: 0.9 Spirit: 1.1
Occupation: Groom (white)
Trait: Horse Whisperer (White) (Communicate with horses)
Skill: Royal Horse (White) Level 2 96100 (Spirit +0.2, preliminary mastery of how to take care of horses)]
That's right, Leo is not a native of this world, and this panel traveled through time with him a year ago.
In his previous life, he was a bounty food delivery knight under a Fortune 500 company.
But a traffic accident sent him to a different world with real knights.
However, compared to the unlucky guys in previous life novels who traveled through time and became fishermen and beggars who had no enough food to eat.
Leo's time travel can be regarded as the beginning of Tianhu. The original body of this body is the only son of a small lord.
Although the territory is not large, he has had enough food and clothing since childhood.
The lord's father also sent him to the great Gray Lion Knight Laughlin a month ago and became a knight's page.
If all goes well, Leo will turn sixteen in two years.
At that time, you will have the opportunity to be made a knight squire and embark on the path of a true great knight.
But before that, more than half a month of feeding horses gave these four servants a blow.
This is supposed to be the job of a stable boy. How can a pampered noble boy endure the filth and stench of a stable?
But Leo was always diligent and conscientious.
Because of the panel, his daily efforts have visible rewards.
Whether it was feeding horses, grooming horses, or cleaning stables, he could gain corresponding experience. He enjoyed it for more than half a month.
When his horse handling skills were upgraded to level two seven days ago, he increased his mental attributes by 0.1 and became more comfortable taking care of horses.
"Father said that horses are mounts and comrades in arms. A qualified knight must learn to take good care of his own war horse." Leo cleaned up the horse manure and began to prepare today's feed.
Cleaning the manger, cutting the fodder, mixing, and stirring, Leo was meticulous in every aspect.
For him, after spending half a month together, these six horses have already developed feelings for him.
Compared with the other three noble children of the same generation.
Simple horses are more comfortable to deal with.
Leo gritted his teeth, picked up the wooden basin, and poured the prepared fodder into the manger at one go.
Then he felt two huge horse heads emerge from his armpits, rubbing against him affectionately.
